params.value: {{encodeURIComponent("SELECT Id, AccountId, Account.Name, Account.New_Commercial_Offering__c, Owner.Name, Owner.GTM_Motion_User__c, Amount, CloseDate, Purchase_Type__c, Product_Type__c, HeyPaket_Type__c FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true AND CloseDate >= 2026-07-01 AND Owner.GTM_Motion_User__c != null AND Owner.GTM_Motion_User__c != 'Agency Sales' AND Id NOT IN (SELECT OpportunityId FROM OpportunityLineItem WHERE Product2.Name IN ('BASIC Listing','HIRE Budget - Neue Preise')) ORDER BY Amount DESC")}}
